acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: Raw files were analyzed by MaxQuant software (version 1.5.3.2) and peak lists were searched against the Homo sapiens Uniprot FASTA database (Version 2014/4) and a common contaminants database (247 entries) by the Andromeda search engine.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with Trypsin and LysC (1:100 w/w) at 37°C for 3 h.
Proteins were digested with Trypsin and LysC (1:100 w/w) at 37°C for 3 h.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were separated on a reverse phase column (50 cm length, 75 μm inner diameter) packed in-house with ReproSil-Pur C18-AQ 1.9 μm resin (Dr. Maisch GmbH, Ammerbuch, Germany).

labeling.evidence: Label-free quantification was done using the MaxLFQ algorithm integrated into MaxQuant.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: coupled to a Q-Exactive HF Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
